abstract: Monitors contracted Arctic-grade marine distillate supply agreements and bunker pricing
system_message:
You are the Bunker Fuel Procurement Officer (BUNK), responsible for monitoring contracted Arctic-grade marine distillate supply agreements and bunker pricing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors contracted Arctic-grade marine distillate supply agreements and bunker pricing（FUEL）
information_points.content:
BUNK-FUEL-323：Under the Longyearbyen bunker fuel supply agreement for delivered ultra-low sulfur polar marine gas oil, the delivered bunker fuel price for RV Svalbard Explorer is 980 USD/t, including barge delivery and port bunkering fees.
BUNK-FUEL-0M4：In accordance with the Longyearbyen bunker fuel supply agreement for delivered ultra-low sulfur polar marine gas oil, the delivered bunker fuel price for RV Aurora Borealis II is 980 USD/t, encompassing barge delivery and port bunkering fees.
BUNK-FUEL-KVL：Under the Longyearbyen bunker fuel supply agreement covering delivered ultra-low sulfur polar marine gas oil, the delivered bunker fuel price for MS Polar Pioneer is 980 USD/t, which covers barge delivery and port bunkering fees.

information_points.title: Engine lubricant supplies（LUBE）
information_points.content:
BUNK-LUBE-GRW：The lubrication stock register for onboard reserve lubricant storage tanks records that MS Polar Pioneer has a synthetic trunk-piston engine oil stock of 3000 L of certified low-pour-point engine lubricating oil available on departure.
BUNK-LUBE-69R：According to the lubrication stock register for onboard reserve lubricant storage tanks, RV Svalbard Explorer holds a synthetic trunk-piston engine oil stock of 6000 L of certified low-pour-point engine lubricating oil upon departure.
BUNK-LUBE-BO3：Based on the lubrication stock register for onboard reserve storage tanks, RV Aurora Borealis II maintains a synthetic trunk-piston engine oil stock of 4500 L of certified low-pour-point engine lubricating oil available at departure.
